      "quote": "app hasn’t worked since the 17th when bugs were allegedly fixed yet majority of people on bedrock especially switch and apple products have had an issue with the game since and there’s been no fix, they claim their aware yet the app hasn’t worked for over 2 weeks now almost 3, with no word on if it ever will work again or if worlds/data is even still there."

      "quote": "my mobile GUI is missing, so I have to guess where the buttons are, and sometimes the screen turns pitch black or pitch white in the middle or a game. And I can’t even see any other GUI besides the title screen. Great. So I can’t even sign out to fix my account bc I have no idea what to do."

      "ref": "[R401]",
      "area": "contact",

      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app crashes after showing the Mojang logo, taking them back to the home screen.",

      "quote": "I love minecraft so much and I play a lot and I have been really wanting to play lately but theres this glitch where it shows the mojang logo and then goes to white and then crashes and takes me back to my home screen and I'm really really sad about this so please FIX IT!!"

      "ref": "[R406]",
      "area": "contact",

      "claim": "A parent reports the new Wild update killed the app, and after many attempts the app still cannot be used on iPad.",

      "ref": "[R408]",

      "area": "contact",

      "quote": "This is a big bug issue I’ve had for a long time. After each update, (especially smaller ones) my game glitches where I can’t SEE the world saves, but they’re still there(if I try hard with muscle memory, I can still play- but it’s extremely difficult) . No buttons, nothing but that rotating world screen. Each time if I want to play the game again, I have to uninstall it and loose all my worlds then reinstall to play again. I’ve lost around 80+ worlds just from wanting to play the game."

    {
      "ref": "[R413]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports only one device cannot play after manual updates, while automatic updates work fine.",

It keeps booting me while it’s loading. PLEASE HELP ME. IVE TRIED EVERYTHING, I REALLY DONT WANT TO NEVER PLAY AGAIN. PLEASE. SOMEBODY. MOJANG."
